about:
Electron Technologies Corporation (ETC) operates from South Windsor, Connecticut, where it provides irradiation processing services to manufacturers across New England. The company describes itself as a fast-growing irradiation processing provider in the region, serving clients that include large firms in multiple sectors.

ETC offers contract irradiation services that cover the full product development cycle. Its team supports customers from initial research and engineering through testing, processing, and final delivery. The company positions its operation as an extension of the client’s own manufacturing line, handling tasks such as radiation polymerization for coatings and other material modification processes.

The company serves the semiconductor, aerospace, plastics, medical device, and gemstone industries. Its customer base consists of what it calls world-class companies that rely on ETC’s expertise and technology to meet manufacturing goals, including sterilization of medical products and aseptic packaging as well as material enhancement for electronic components.

ETC states that its differentiation lies in a commitment to superior quality service with fast turnaround at a reasonable price. Its philosophy centers on acting as an extension of the customer’s manufacturing process, guiding projects from concept through to finished product.
